description: Surviving mutants a maintainer has looked at and accepted: equivalent ones (no input can tell them apart from the original) and ones that only make a check stricter. mutation_check.py leaves these out of its report. An entry matches by module, cosmic-ray operator and the stripped text of the source line, so it follows the line when code above it moves and stops matching when the line itself changes. tests/test_mutation_check.py fails when an entry's line no longer exists. Say in reason why the mutant cannot matter.

accepted.reason: How long cosmic-ray waits for one mutant's tests is a tuning value; 119 or 121 seconds changes no outcome a test can observe.
